verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: And to the children of Israel, it shall be said: “Each man among the children of Israel, and every foreigner who lives in Israel, who gives his seed to the king, shall die. His people will be destroyed by the rod of God.”
verses.3: And I will face that man, and I will recognize him from among his people. For from his lineage came the king, so that he could profane my holy things and destroy the name of my holiness.
verses.4: And if the world destroys the people of the land, cutting off their eyes from that man through his descendants, so that they cannot become kings… then I will not kill him.
verses.5: And I turned my face towards that man, along with his family. I recognized him, as well as all his relatives. They were considered slaves to the king among their people.
verses.6: And the soul that turns towards its ancestors and those who possess knowledge, so that it can follow in their footsteps… I will face that soul, and I will recognize it as belonging to my people.
verses.7: And you shall become holy and be consecrated, for I, the LORD your God, am holy.
verses.8: And you shall keep My commandments, and you shall carry them out. I, the LORD, will make you holy.
verses.9: For every man who insults his father and mother, he will die. His father and mother will also insult him in return.
verses.10: And a man who marries the wife of his neighbor will die along with the one who is married to his neighbor’s wife.
verses.11: And anyone who sleeps with his father’s wife will be cursed by his father. Their blood will be shed together.
verses.12: And whoever lies down with his feet will die. Both of them will die. They will shed their blood together.
verses.13: And anyone who lies with a woman’s body will be punished. Both of them will die, and their blood will be shed upon them.
verses.14: And anyone who takes a woman and her mother as wives, they will be burned by fire. They shall not be married to them.
verses.15: And anyone who gives his bed to a horse will die, and the horse will be destroyed.
verses.16: And a woman who approaches every animal to mate with it. You kill that woman and the animal as well. Their blood will be on them.
verses.17: And anyone who takes one of his own children, either from his father or from his mother, and then sees the evil that comes from that relationship, and he also sees the evil that comes from his own actions… Then his mercy will be forgotten by the people of his nation. The evil of his own actions will be revealed, and he will be punished.
verses.18: And he who sleeps with a woman, and reveals her shame and her disgrace, will also be punished. Both of them will be marked as sinners among their people.
verses.19: And do not show any hatred towards your sister and your father’s sister. For if you do so, they will be punished.
verses.20: And anyone who sleeps with his father’s wife will be exposed to the disgrace of his father’s sin. They will be shamed, and they will die.
verses.21: And anyone who takes the wife of his brother will be despised by his brother. He will cause his brother to suffer greatly.
verses.22: And you shall keep all my laws and all my decrees. You shall carry out them, and the earth will not be cursed with you, for I have brought you there to settle in it.
verses.23: And do not follow the laws of that nation whom I have sent against you. For they have all done these things, and I will punish them for it.
verses.24: And I said to you, “You shall inherit your land. But I will give it to you as an inheritance. It is the land of milk and honey. I, Jehovah your God, have separated you from other nations.”
verses.25: And you shall distinguish between the pure and the impure animals, and between the impure and the pure birds. Do not entangle your souls in either animals or birds, nor in anything else that you may touch on the land which I have made for you.
verses.26: You will be holy to me, for I am holy. I will take you out of the nations and make you my own.
verses.27: And neither man nor woman shall be left in their graves, or know the death of those who died. Their blood will be shed upon them.
